next_resolution_rules: Find a maker-owned storefront/social channel before upgrading a reseller-only maker identity to primary.
Retain defunct/historical makers because their figures remain in collections and aftermarket listings.
Treat collaboration labels as many-to-many relationships rather than manufacturers.
Never infer factory ownership or brand equivalence from shared mold style, code prefix, packaging or reseller category alone.
